title: Tuning recombination and charge separation in a n/p/p heterojunction solar cell with CZTS, Ag3SbS3 and a carbon interlayer
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2024, 8,5887-5905
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE00495G, Paper
Ponnada Yallam Naidu, Manoranjan Ojha, Souvik Naskar, Melepurath Deepa
An n/p/p heterojunction solar cell taps the synergy between the photosensitizers: CdS (n-type) and CZTS (p-type) nanocrystals and Ag3SbS3 (p-type) quantum dots to yield an efficiency of 9.76%.
